This page will walk through everything you need installed before the first class.
A quick list of what we'll use:

- A terminal and a code editor (VS Code recommended).
- [Git](https://git-scm.com/) for version control.
- A [GitHub](https://github.com/) account.
- An agentic coding tool ([Claude Code](https://www.claude.com/product/claude-code)).
- Language runtimes as needed per build (e.g., Node, Python, R / Quarto).
